scope: Four independently installable wheels and one exact-version collection

components.purpose: Check exact declared handler interfaces and required metadata presence without opening payloads.
components.use_case: Review an invented service-summary job before a separate dispatch decision.
components.establishes: Check exact declared handler interfaces and required metadata presence without opening payloads.

components.purpose: Recompute supplied lease ownership, renewal, expiry and takeover history at an explicit as-of ordinal.
components.use_case: Explain a declared takeover from worker-alpha to worker-beta at the exclusive expiry boundary.
components.establishes: Recompute supplied lease ownership, renewal, expiry and takeover history at an explicit as-of ordinal.
does_not_establish: Worker authentication or real clock validation

components.purpose: Account for selected delivery and acknowledgement claims against supplied lease history.
components.use_case: Find a former owner acknowledgement after takeover without erasing a consistent current delivery.
components.establishes: Account for selected delivery and acknowledgement claims against supplied lease history.
does_not_establish: Verified broker delivery or sent acknowledgements

components.purpose: Check selected result and commit claims against exact work-item, delivery and declared ownership records.
components.use_case: Withhold qualification for a result commit after lease expiry or multiple commit identities for one item.
components.establishes: Check selected result and commit claims against exact work-item, delivery and declared ownership records.
does_not_establish: Verified artifact bytes or durable commit
Handler execution or actual store contents

collection.dependency_rule: Install all five reviewed wheels from one directory; exact-version dependencies resolve offline.

related_systems.adapter_status: not implemented; single-operator workspace locking and fake notification attempts do not provide worker leases or broker acknowledgements. Explicit handler/item revisions, identity, hash-domain, clock, ownership-event, delivery, result and commit-evidence mappings are required.
